scopes.never: Appointments, members and settings are never shared with doctors.
scopes.noneWarning: With every section off, the doctor sees only the baby's name and age.

hints.daily_log: Sleep, feeds, diapers, symptoms and temperatures, and the patterns computed from them.
hints.medications: Medications, prescriptions, doses given and the status of the doctor's suggestions.
hints.vaccines: Vaccination records and what is due.
hints.formulas: Formulas in use and their history.
hints.notes: The doctor's notes and recommendations shared with you.

access.title: Doctor access
access.intro: Choose what {{doctor}} sees of {{baby}}. Changes apply right away.
access.seesNothing: Sees only the name and age

accept.title: You now follow {{name}}
accept.sharedNothing: The family has not shared any section yet: you see only the name and age.

patients.title: Patients
patients.emptyBody: A family adds you from their baby's Members: they create a doctor invite link, choose what to share and send it to you. Opening the link while signed in adds the baby to this list.
patients.emptyProfile: Families see the name of your professional profile, in Settings.
patients.offline: Offline: showing the patients saved on this device. The numbers come back when you are online.
patients.loadFailed: Could not load your patients' numbers. Try again.

switcher.title: Change patient
switcher.shortcut: Tip: the [ and ] keys move between patients.

patient.notFound: This baby is not on your patient list. The family may have removed your access.

notShared.title: Not shared with you
notShared.body: The family did not share {{section}}. They can change it in their baby's Members.

summary.rangeInvalid: Choose a start on or before the end, at most 92 days.
summary.offline: Offline: the summary needs a connection.
summary.loadFailed: Could not load the summary. Try again.

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.totalHelp: Average over the days with sleep logged; today counts only when it is the only one. Pauses are left out, and a sleep across midnight is split between the two days.
sleep.nightHelp: Average per day of the sleep logged as night.
sleep.napsHelp: Average number of naps that started each day, and their time. A sleep without a kind counts as a nap.
sleep.longestHelp: The longest single sleep that started in the period, pauses left out.
sleep.bedtimeHelp: Median of the evenings: the first bedtime mark from 15:00 to 03:00, else the start of the first night sleep then.
sleep.wakeHelp: Median of the mornings: the latest end of a night sleep from 03:00 to 12:00, else the first wake-up mark from 04:00 to 11:00.
sleep.chart: Sleep per day: night and naps

feeding.title: Feeding
feeding.perDayHelp: Average over the days with feeds logged, each feed on the day it started; today counts only when it is the only one.
feeding.intervalHelp: Average time between the starts of consecutive feeds; gaps over 8 hours are left out (probably a feed not logged).
feeding.mlHelp: Average of the logged bottle amounts per day, over the days with an amount.

diapers.title: Diapers
diapers.perDayHelp: Average over the days with diapers logged; a mixed diaper counts as wet and as dirty.

symptoms.title: Symptoms and temperatures
symptoms.help: As the family logged them, newest first: temperatures, symptoms, spit-ups, belly pain and teething.

medications.title: Medications
medications.dosesHelp: Counted from the doses the family logged, per medication.
medications.noDoses: No doses logged in this period.

vaccines.title: Vaccines
vaccines.help: From the vaccination records and the schedule the family follows, as on their Vaccines page.

growth.title: Growth
growth.noPercentiles: Percentile curves are not shown yet.

notes.title: Notes
notes.none: No notes of yours in this period.

timeline.readOnly: Read only: these are the family's entries.
timeline.loadFailed: Could not load this day. Try again.
timeline.offline: Offline: the timeline needs a connection.

medications.prescriptionsHelp: The baby's prescriptions, as the family keeps them. To change one, propose a change below.

leave.title: Stop following {{name}}?
leave.body: You lose access to {{name}} right away. The notes you shared stay with the family; your pending proposals are cancelled.
